raw_feedback_text: Issue - The Base Structure depth and Length are significantly more than the Valve. This does not match the recommendation provided to User. When an inline component like GD-VLV or GD-B is plotted with required dimensions, and GD-ST or GD-SB are then dimensioned to suit these components, the GD-ST / SB need to be modified from their default EDAS dimension parameters.

structured_feedback.affected_requirement: Support/protection structures must be dimensioned to the supported/protected component envelope.
structured_feedback.affected_function: produce a preliminary plot whose GD-ST/GD-SB dimensions match the stated assembly recommendation
structured_feedback.affected_behavior: avoid excessive support depth/length that may add stiffness, offset, strain, or bending effects without evidence
structured_feedback.affected_constraint: Do not use generic EDAS default dimensions for GD-ST/GD-SB when they are introduced to suit a specific GD-VLV, GD-B, or similar component.
structured_feedback.pmap_issue: The plotted GD-SB used default dimensions much larger than the valve while the explanation recommended valve-fitted protection geometry.
